from rcb_hb import Session
import numpy as np
import mujoco
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

class Controller:
    def __init__(self,s):
        self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=s.data
        self.ikd=mujoco.MjData(self.m)
        self.lo=self.m.actuator_ctrlrange[:,0];self.span=np.ptp(self.m.actuator_ctrlrange,axis=1)
        self.home=np.zeros(self.m.nu)
        self.home[[2,7]]=-.4;self.home[[3,8]]=.8;self.home[[4,9]]=-.4
        self.qadr=np.array([self.m.jnt_qposadr[j] if t==0 else -1 for j,t in zip(self.m.actuator_trnid[:,0],self.m.actuator_trntype)])
        self.vadr=np.array([self.m.jnt_dofadr[j] if t==0 else -1 for j,t in zip(self.m.actuator_trnid[:,0],self.m.actuator_trntype)])
        self.armidx=[np.array([11,12,13,14,15,21,22]),np.array([16,17,18,19,20,41,42])]
        self.palms=[self.m.body(x).id for x in ['lh_palm','rh_palm']]
        self.jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));self.jr=self.jp.copy()
    def norm(self,u):return np.clip(2*(u-self.lo)/self.span-1,-1,1)
    def ik(self,side,pos,rot=None,offset=None,seed=None,n=20):
        ids=self.armidx[side];qa=self.qadr[ids];va=self.vadr[ids];bid=self.palms[side]
        self.ikd.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos
        if seed is not None:self.ikd.qpos[qa]=seed
        dd=self.ikd
        for _ in range(n):
            mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,dd);mujoco.mj_comPos(self.m,dd)
            R=dd.xmat[bid].reshape(3,3)
            point=dd.xpos[bid]+(R@offset if offset is not None else 0)
            mujoco.mj_jac(self.m,dd,self.jp,self.jr,point,bid)
            err=pos-point;J=self.jp[:,va]
            if rot is not None:
                er=Rotation.from_matrix(rot@R.T).as_rotvec()
                err=np.r_[err,er*.15];J=np.vstack([J,self.jr[:,va]*.15])
            delta=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(len(err))*.0001,err)
            dd.qpos[qa]+=np.clip(delta,-.15,.15)
            dd.qpos[qa]=np.clip(dd.qpos[qa],self.lo[ids],self.lo[ids]+self.span[ids])
            if np.linalg.norm(err)<.0005:break
        return dd.qpos[qa].copy()
    def details(self):
        d=self.d
        return {'pelvis':np.round(d.qpos[:3],4).tolist(),'upright':round(d.xmat[12,8],4), 'sockets':np.round(d.site_xpos[[9,10]],4).tolist(),'bar':np.round(d.site_xpos[[12,11]],4).tolist(),'hands':np.round(d.site_xpos[[7,8]],4).tolist()}
